response.message: We'll pull synthetic logs and traces from Cloud Logging and Cloud Trace, scrub personal data with Sensitive Data Protection, and store and search the results in BigQuery. A Cloud Run analyst then asks Gemini on Vertex AI to explain the incident, treating every log line as untrusted data, and sends operators an answer that cites the source log and trace IDs. For the first local test, we'll run the analyst against a fixed set of synthetic incident records and a scripted model response, so it only shows that the plumbing and citations work: it doesn't prove Gemini's reasoning, quotas or that it's available in a given region, and nothing has been deployed. Which country must this telemetry stay in, so we can pick a region later?

proposal.title: Google Cloud incident correlation: logs + traces to cited AI explanation
proposal.body: Scope: synthetic logs/traces collected, redacted, stored/searchable, analysed by a Vertex AI-backed Cloud Run runtime, answered to an operator with source evidence. Assumptions: synthetic data only, region and project/account access not selected or approved, model ID unselected. Design-only; no native generator coverage for these GCP services, no deployment.

data.label: Synthetic services (log/trace emitters)
data.description: Synthetic workloads emitting structured logs and OpenTelemetry traces. Outside provisioning scope.

data.label: Telemetry collection
data.description: Receives logs and traces; a log sink routes entries plus trace IDs to Pub/Sub for redaction.
data.service: Cloud Logging + Cloud Trace (log sink to Pub/Sub)

data.label: Redaction worker
data.description: De-identifies secrets/PII before storage; keeps original record IDs for evidence. Raw unredacted text is not persisted beyond short retention.
data.service: Cloud Run job + Sensitive Data Protection

data.label: Telemetry store & search
data.description: Holds redacted logs and spans joined by trace_id; time-window and service queries feed analysis.
data.service: BigQuery (redacted logs + spans, partitioned by time)

data.label: Incident analysis runtime
data.description: Queries correlated evidence, wraps log text as untrusted quoted data, calls the model, validates that every claim cites log/span IDs, abstains when evidence is insufficient. Returns the cited explanation to the operator.
data.service: Cloud Run service (service account, read-only BigQuery)

data.label: LLM
data.description: Generates the explanation from supplied evidence only. Regional availability and quota unverified.
data.service: Vertex AI Gemini (model ID to be selected)

data.label: On-call operator
data.description: Asks about an incident and receives an explanation with source log/trace evidence. Authenticated via IAP (to be confirmed).

requirementDrafts.rationale: Prompt injection via log lines could produce misleading incident explanations.
requirementDrafts.statement: Proposed: the analysis runtime treats log and trace text as untrusted data; instructions embedded in it must not change model behaviour or trigger actions.

requirementDrafts.rationale: Prevents secrets/PII leaking into search and model prompts.
requirementDrafts.statement: Proposed: sensitive values are redacted before telemetry is stored or sent to the model.

requirementDrafts.rationale: Operators must verify conclusions; uncited claims risk wrong remediation.
requirementDrafts.statement: Proposed: every explanation cites the log entry and span IDs it relies on, or abstains if evidence is insufficient.

Do not just recite a checklist or demand that a junior developer repair product internals. Offer a concrete supported correction when possible; otherwise ask one focused question and explain why its answer matters. Help improve this architecture from its current emulation results. A local emulation pass is not a cloud plan or deployment. After an applied correction, rerun emulation on the new artifact; do not reuse this result. response.message: Here's what's working: the emulation recorded no test failures, and the end-to-end flow is intact, with collection, redaction, BigQuery, the Cloud Run analyst, Gemini and cited answers for the operator. It's blocked because the generator has no Google Cloud implementation for any of these parts: the only typed GCP contract is private object storage, and using it would shrink our app down to storage. So I'm not proposing a diagram change. A diagram edit can't fix this; it needs product engineering work on native GCP generators (Pub/Sub log sink, Cloud Run with Sensitive Data Protection, BigQuery, a Vertex AI call), and this report (artifact 2010777e…) can be the reproducer. Nothing has run on a real model, in a region or in a deployment yet. While that work is pending, here's the decision that most shapes those generators: which country must the telemetry and model calls stay in, for example "EU only" or "Australia"?
